mapper.select: select * from walk_member where activity_id = #{activityId} and mobile = #{mobile} and del_flag = '0'
select * from walk_member where activity_id = #{activityId} and openid = #{openid} and del_flag = '0'
select * from walk_member where activity_id = #{activityId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0'

select member_id, activity_id, real_name, mobile, dept_id from walk_member where del_flag = '0' and activity_id = #{activityId} and signup_status = '1' and (real_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or mobile like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) order by signup_time desc limit 20
mapper.update: update walk_member set openid = #{openid}, miniprogram_bind_status = '1', step_auth_status = #{stepAuthStatus}, update_time = sysdate() where member_id = #{memberId}
